election_rules.title: Voter Eligibility
election_rules.content: Only registered and verified voters can participate. The minimum voting age for this prototype is 18 years. A voter must appear in the official voter list and meet the applicable citizenship requirements.

election_rules.title: One Person One Vote
election_rules.content: Each eligible voter may cast only one vote in an election. The system checks voting status before accepting a ballot and rejects duplicate votes.

election_rules.title: Vote Privacy
election_rules.content: Voter identity verification is separated from ballot storage so election officers cannot see who a voter selected.

voting_procedure.title: Step 1: Login
voting_procedure.content: Open the election portal and sign in with your registered account credentials.

voting_procedure.title: Step 2: Identity Verification
voting_procedure.content: Complete verification using OTP, MFA, or the method configured by the election system.

voting_procedure.title: Step 3: Open Ballot
voting_procedure.content: After verification, open the active election ballot assigned to your voter profile.

voting_procedure.title: Step 4: Select Candidate
voting_procedure.content: Review the candidate list, select one candidate, and confirm your choice carefully before submission.

voting_procedure.title: Step 5: Submit and Confirm
voting_procedure.content: Submit your ballot. The system shows a confirmation message or receipt reference. After successful submission, another vote in the same election is rejected.

voting_locations.title: Online Voting Location
voting_locations.content: You can vote online through the official Secure Election System web portal after login and identity verification.

voting_locations.title: Assigned Election Access
voting_locations.content: Your account only shows elections you are eligible for. If no ballot appears, your voter record may be unregistered, ineligible, or outside the voting period.

voting_locations.title: Support Channels
voting_locations.content: For portal access issues, use the official election help desk or support contact published by the election authority.

election_schedule.title: Registration Period
election_schedule.content: Voter registration must be completed before the official registration deadline.

election_schedule.title: Voting Period
election_schedule.content: Votes can be cast only during the official voting start and end window defined for the election.

election_schedule.title: Result Declaration
election_schedule.content: Results are released after voting ends and audit checks are completed by the election authority.

faqs.title: Can I vote more than once?
faqs.content: No. Each eligible voter can cast only one vote per election. Duplicate attempts are blocked.

faqs.title: Can election officers see my vote?
faqs.content: No. The system is designed to keep voter identity separate from the submitted ballot choice.

faqs.title: What if I selected the wrong candidate?
faqs.content: Review your selection before final confirmation. After final submission, the vote usually cannot be changed.

faqs.title: How do I know my vote was submitted?
faqs.content: After successful submission, the portal shows a confirmation message or receipt reference.

faqs.title: Where can I vote?
faqs.content: You can vote on the official online election portal after login and verification. Your account displays only the elections you are eligible to participate in.

security_information.title: Duplicate Vote Prevention
security_information.content: Before accepting a ballot, the backend checks whether the voter has already voted in that election.

security_information.title: Audit Logs
security_information.content: Important actions such as login, verification, and vote submission are recorded in audit logs for accountability.
